lines: A queen sent a fortune. He sent it back.
The Queen of Sheba sent him a rich gift, to test what kind of king he was.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, said: What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you.
What Allah gave you is worth more than anything anyone can hand you. Full movie below.

beats.text: A queen sent a fortune. He sent it back.
beats.ur: ایک ملکہ نے خزانہ بھیجا… انہوں نے واپس کر دیا

beats.text: A rich gift… to test what kind of king he was.
beats.ur: ایک قیمتی تحفہ… یہ دیکھنے کو کہ وہ کیسا بادشاہ ہے

beats.en: Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allah has given me is better than what He has given you

beats.text: What Allah gave you is worth more than anything anyone can hand you.
beats.ur: جو اللہ نے آپ کو دیا، وہ ہر اس چیز سے بہتر ہے جو کوئی آپ کو دے
